profile: release / fat LTO / one codegen unit
notes: Worktree follow-up to 52f9e18. Baseline binaries are the previously deployed packing implementation, whose physics is identical after its rebase.
Supported-cell recovery is used only after the ordinary plan fails and the group is quiet for 1.5 seconds. Candidate counts, movement radii, and the eight-surface-check limit are unchanged.

Failed decisions can be reused only with unchanged exact current collision dependencies, terrain revision, ordered group, gravity samples and recovery eligibility. Success always runs fresh clearance. At most 64 failures and 256 nearby collider dependencies per failure are retained.

32 serial runner executions: 20 desktop and 12 Picade. These are single paired runs, not a replicated performance distribution. Desktop explores Scorched seeds 42, 4242 and 777; Picade repeats seed 42.

Scorched runs last 120 simulated seconds with 60 seconds bombardment, 192 grains, auditing and full replay. Timing excludes diagnostics, capture, replay and rendering. Spacewars runs last 30 seconds and include combat/match in both shapes plus loose-off controls.

Picade kiosk pause is checked before and after every run. Telemetry endpoints are temperature in millidegrees C, CPU0 frequency in kHz and undervoltage alarm. Some endpoints exceed 80 C; endpoint frequency does not rule out intervening thermal throttling. Interpret timing as an observed device comparison, not controlled-clock microbenchmarking.

Collapse-off before/after state hashes match in both games. All Scorched runs conserve their initial cell counts and replay; both games match final desktop/Picade hashes for corresponding seed-42 runs.

All six revised Scorched collapse-enabled runs stop releasing additional material during the last 30 seconds. Some final loose counts regress, notably seed-42 Angular Scorched and Round Spacewars match. Collapse remains optional.
Spacewars rotating scenes have no observed reused failures in the sampled 30-second runs. Exact-pose invalidation preserves correctness there; the recovery ordering accounts for the changed results.
